entries.title: Absolute Difference
entries.description: Two's-complement absolute difference between two integers.

entries.title: Absolute Value
entries.description: Absolute value of a signed integer, without branches.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: every 1- and 2-op component library at 32-bit refuted by the solver.

entries.title: Average, Rounded Up
entries.description: Average of two integers, rounded up on ties.

entries.title: Average, Rounded Down
entries.description: Average of two integers, rounded down on ties.

entries.title: Reverse Bits (32-bit)
entries.description: Reverses the bit order of a 32-bit integer.

entries.title: Byte Swap (32-bit)
entries.description: Reverses the byte order of a 32-bit integer.

entries.title: Clear Lowest Set Bit
entries.description: Clears the lowest set bit of an integer.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: every 1-op component library at 32-bit refuted by the solver.

entries.title: Ceiling Power of Two
entries.description: Rounds an integer up to the nearest power of two.

entries.title: Floor Power of Two
entries.description: Rounds an integer down to the nearest power of two.

entries.title: Isolate Highest Set Bit
entries.description: Isolates the highest set bit of an integer as a single set bit.

entries.title: Isolate Lowest Zero Bit
entries.description: Isolates the lowest unset bit as a single set bit.

entries.title: Isolate Rightmost Bit
entries.description: Extracts the lowest set bit, clearing everything else.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: every 1-op component library at 32-bit refuted by the solver.

entries.title: Parity
entries.description: Computes the parity of the set bits in an integer.

entries.title: Population Count
entries.description: Counts the number of set bits in an integer.

entries.title: Rotate Left by 5
entries.description: Rotates an integer left by five bit positions.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: every 1- and 2-op component library at 32-bit refuted by the solver.

entries.title: Round Down to Multiple of Eight
entries.description: Rounds an integer down to the nearest multiple of eight.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: passing the input straight through is not equivalent to this spec at 32-bit.

entries.title: Round Up to Multiple of Eight
entries.description: Rounds an integer up to the nearest multiple of eight.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: every 1-op component library at 32-bit refuted by the solver.

entries.title: Sign
entries.description: Returns the sign of an integer as -1, 0, or 1.

entries.title: Sign-Extend Byte
entries.description: Sign-extends the low byte of an integer to the full width.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: every 1-op component library at 32-bit refuted by the solver.

entries.title: Smear Lowest Set Bit
entries.description: Sets every bit at or below the lowest set bit.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: every 1-op component library at 32-bit refuted by the solver.

entries.title: Swap Halves
entries.description: Swaps the upper and lower halves of an integer.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: every 1- and 2-op component library at 32-bit refuted by the solver.

entries.title: Multiply by Nine
entries.description: Multiplies an integer by nine.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: every 1-op component library other than multiply refuted by the solver at 32-bit.
entries.cost_note: By instruction count the multiply wins at 1; by the latency cost model a shift-and-add pair is cheaper — see the cost model writeup in the engine repo.

entries.title: Turn Off Trailing Ones
entries.description: Clears the trailing run of set bits starting at bit zero.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: every 1-op component library at 32-bit refuted by the solver.

entries.title: Turn On Lowest Zero Bit
entries.description: Sets the lowest unset bit of an integer, turning it on.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: every 1-op component library at 32-bit refuted by the solver.

entries.title: Zero High Half
entries.description: Clears the upper sixteen bits of a 32-bit integer.
entries.floor_note: No shorter program exists: passing the input straight through is not equivalent to this spec at 32-bit.
